notes: The harness was stopped (this run's own process group, verified by PID, parent and start time) before its finally block, so the ceiling was restored by hand through the normal account API.
The Claude-fixed test task could not be cancelled once started ("Use the thread controls for a task that has started"); its thread was left to finish rather than interrupt a provider turn.

That receipt was a consequence of this run stopping its own harness, not a product account-routing result. It was replaced by this evidence-based receipt. The restoration proof is independent: PATCH /hub/accounts for Gmail returned 200 with ceilingPct 90 at 00:34:38Z, and a fresh GET /hub/accounts showed Gmail 90, Ekoa 90 and Ekoa Codex 90.
